'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
